title: Register with Colorado SecureSavings or certify a retirement plan exemption
description: Employers in business at least two years with five or more employees and no qualified plan must register or certify an exemption. Penalty: $100 per eligible employee a year, up to $5,000, enforced one year after an employer's due date; pre-enforcement letters began August 15, 2025.

appliesWhen.description: 5 or more employees in the state

exemptions: Employers that sponsor a qualified retirement plan (they still certify the exemption)
